title: NRI deposit flows fall 16% to $11.2 bn in Apr-Dec 2025: RBI data
summary: RBI data: NRI deposit inflows (FCNR, NRE, NRO) dropped 15.97% to $11.20 billion in Apr-Dec 2025 from $13.33 billion in 2024.
